pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṅkamitvā chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo ovadanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.5: yampi mayaṃ ayye gaccheyyāma ovādassa kāraṇā ayyā chabbaggiyā idheva amhe ovadantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṅkamitvā bhikkhuniyo ovadantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.8: athakho tā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.9: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.10: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṅkamitvā bhikkhuniyo ovadantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.11: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṅkamitvā bhikkhuniyo ovadathāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.14: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṅkamitvā bhikkhuniyo ovadissatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.16: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.17.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṅkamitvā bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.18: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.1: tena kho pana samayena mahāpajāpati gotamī gilānā hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.2: therā bhikkhū yena mahāpajāpati gotamī tenupasaṅkamiṃsu
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.4: kacci te gotami khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.5: na me ayyā khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.7: na tāva bhagini kappati bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṅkamitvā bhikkhuniyā dhammaṃ desetunti kukkuccāyantā na desesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.8: athakho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena mahāpajāpati gotamī tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.9: nisajja kho bhagavā mahāpajātiṃ gotamiṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.10: kacci te gotami khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.11: pubbe me bhante therā bhikkhū āgantvā dhammaṃ desenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.13: idāni pana bhagavatā paṭikkhittanti kukkuccāyantā na desenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.15: athakho bhagavā mahāpajātiṃ gotamiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.16: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.17: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṅkamitvā gilānaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ovadituṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.18: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.19.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṅkamitvā bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya aññatra samayā pācittiyaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.20: tatthāyaṃ samayo gilānā hoti bhikkhunī ayaṃ tattha samayoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:3.1.16: na sakkoti ovādāya vā saṃvāsāya vā gantuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:3.2.1: upasampannāya upasampannasaññī bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṅkamitvā aññatra samayā ovadati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:3.2.2: upasampannāya vematiko bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṅkamitvā aññatra samayā ovadati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:3.2.3: upasampannāya anupasampannasaññī bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṅkamitvā aññatra samayā ovadati āpatti pācittiyassa.
